column1: # tests/expected/air_gc_legacy.tsv — the legacy control for #182: an original character's guard-cancel motion from a
# ground and an air block, P1's block / guard-window / commit / command / sequence bytes per event
# (tests/audit_air_gc_legacy.sh; tests/lua/read_tap.lua, non-debug). Evidence class: in-emulator (MAME, pristine vsavj,
# native vsav2 and the WIDE build m3b_merged28). Frozen 14z-185 (GitHub #182) with FREEZE=1, its rule-checker run named
# in the commit. A non-zero window158 write or a commit3b5 := 06 in E1/E2 on any leg, or a leg whose rows stop equalling
# Rows for phobos are the POSITIVE leg (native vsav2 only): the same rig commits an air guard cancel there.
# Columns: character, leg (vsavj | vsav2 | ours), event (- | E0 ground 2800 | E1 air 3220 | E2 air 3640), field, value
#   ids: the last pre-match id byte per fighter (real picks, never poked)
#   block140 / window158 / commit3b5 / x147 / air38 / cmd106 / seq06: every write of P1's byte +0x140 / +0x158 / +0x3B5
#   (the guard-cancel commit writes 06) / +0x147 / +0x38 (airborne) / +0x106 / +0x06 in [t-10, t+70), as
#   <frame>:<byte hex>, in write order; "-" when none
#   commit_pc: every PC that wrote +0x3B5 := 06 in the event (the commit routine: vsavj/ours 029c6e, vs2 028fa0)
# Frame numbers are read_tap.lua's WRITE labels (a write labelled N is replay.lua's frame N+1,
# docs/platform/gotchas.md); every leg is read by the same instrument, so they compare exactly.
